classification: OPEN ARITHMETIC OBLIGATIONS; thresholds are exact conditional reductions
weight: fixed nonnegative smooth w in the audited Li-Liu class
target_range: N even, X/2 <= N <= X, N in H

obligations.name: pointwise_major_lower_bound
obligations.quantified_form: Under the stated Li-Liu common zero hypothesis and the weight/arc hypotheses of Proposition 4.1, there exist c_A(w,Theta,kappa)>0 and X_0 such that a_w(N) >= c_A X for every X>=X_0 and every even N in [X/2,X]; in particular this holds on H intersect [X/2,X].
obligations.provenance: Li-Liu Proposition 4.1 under its common Dirichlet-L zero hypothesis; conditional external input, verify exact theorem conditions before use.

obligations.name: uniform_signed_increment_energy
obligations.quantified_form: For J_X={2,4,...,2m} with distinct shifts and N+J_X within the coefficient range, prove sup_{N in H intersect [X/2,X]} sum_{j in J_X}|m_w(N+j)-m_w(N)|^2 <= V_X, with V_X < m(c_A X - sqrt((B_X-c_A^2 X^2)/m))^2 whenever B_X>c_A^2 X^2 and m>(B_X-c_A^2 X^2)/(c_A^2 X^2).
obligations.provenance: No cited theorem supplies this target-uniform signed prime-only estimate; global fourth moment plus Gram geometry gives order m B_X instead.

obligations.name: localized_disjoint_fourth_moment_profile
obligations.quantified_form: For the nearest-rational disjoint bins E_{a/q,s}, prove independent upper bounds Bbar_{q,s}(X) for every reduced a/q, q<=X^kappa, and shell s, such that the exact allocation functional Vbar_X=(max_{||z||=1} sum_{a,q,s} sqrt(Bbar_{q,s}) sqrt(z*G_{a/q,s}z))^2 satisfies the strict Stage66 threshold uniformly for every N in H intersect [X/2,X].
obligations.provenance: Li-Liu's cited result controls only the total minor-arc fourth moment at the scale O(X^(5/2)(log X)^100); no such resolved profile was established in the audited source.

obligations.name: independent_signed_arc_cancellation
obligations.quantified_form: For a reflection-symmetric partition and every N in H intersect [X/2,X], prove sum_r Re(c_r(N)) > -a_w(N), where c_r(N)=integral_{E_r} S_w(alpha)^2 e(-N alpha)d alpha, using a prime theorem not assuming R(N)>0.
obligations.provenance: This is sufficient but equivalent to direct positivity after summing the arc decomposition; a stronger norm bound is also open.
obligations.status: OPEN; LOGICALLY TAUTOLOGICAL UNLESS PROVED INDEPENDENTLY

obligations.name: base3_position_distribution
obligations.quantified_form: Prove a uniform lower bound for the number/weight of prime pairs p=3+2a, q=3+2b with a+b=N/2-3 and both endpoints prime, for all N in H, with explicit dependence on the wheel-210 residue classes.
obligations.provenance: Wheel admissibility establishes local possibility only, not simultaneous primality or a signed Fourier estimate.
obligations.status: OPEN; THIS IS A REFORMULATION OF A TARGET-SPECIFIC PRIME-PAIR THEOREM

global_scale.B_X: O(X^(5/2)(log X)^100), conditional on the common zero-free hypothesis
global_scale.minimum_shift_order_even_at_zero_variati: m+1 > B_X/A_X^2, hence order X^(1/2)(log X)^100
